title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Extended Protocol Errors Work Item
summary: Implement four extended protocol error enforcement mechanisms: EDNS(0) tcp-keepalive rejection, server-initiated bidirectional stream detection, missing STREAM FIN timeout, and unknown/unexpected-context error code normalization.
planned_changes:
- Add EDNS(0) tcp-keepalive option scanner to DoqMessageCodec and wire it into DoqStream.ReadSingleMessageUntilFinAsync to reject messages containing the forbidden option.
- Add StreamFinTimeout property to DoqClient and apply it in QueryAsync via WaitAsync on the read-until-FIN operation.
- Add inbound stream monitor to DoqClient that treats any server-initiated bidirectional stream as a fatal protocol error.
- Add NormalizeReceivedErrorCode helper to DoqErrorCode to map unknown and unexpected-context error codes to UnspecifiedError.
- Add focused tests: EDNS keepalive rejection, server-initiated bidirectional stream rejection, FIN timeout enforcement, and error code normalization.
verification_plan: Run the DoQ fatal protocol-error tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: DoQ server-side outbound stream prevention (satisfied by construction in the existing adapter).
Padding, AXFR/IXFR, 0-RTT, Retry/address validation, gateway rewriting.
Context-sensitive error code mapping beyond the basic known-code vs unknown-code classification.
EDNS option code probing beyond tcp-keepalive (option 11).
completion_notes: All extended protocol error mechanisms are implemented with focused tests. The DoQ adapter now validates EDNS(0) tcp-keepalive, monitors for server-initiated streams, enforces a configurable FIN timeout, and normalizes unknown error codes to UnspecifiedError.
